text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (December 4, 2025) for 1143 O'Connor Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 13, 2025), for 1143 O'Connor Drive, Folder No. 25 260252 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to August 31, 2026.
